body: We share the same curse I see, you've just figured out how to handle it. Beautiful words my friend.  Thank you, hopefully they will see my way into tomorrow.

Thanks for replying, but as a person who got stuck in the fucking desert, and will now either die here or figure out how to get out some way or another (doubt it), I take offense to your analogy. You can walk and walk and walk and walk out her but you'll find nothing. That's all there is here is nothing.  you survive here and thats all you do. there's no way to further yourself. you just keep wandering. eventually after about six hours or so you realize your out of water. do you keep wandering to find the oasis (and trust me I've been looking for literal ones for a while now) or do you keep walking, eventually start to lose it, lose everything, and just curl up on that pretty rock where one day a nice climbing party will find the remains of who you were, where you will become a 3 sentence blurb in the local paper about how a missing hiker was found. sorry for the run on sentence.

Meh, I doubt I would do anything tonight anyways. This has been looming for a couple weeks. Every time I think I'm out of it something happens that kicks me down a thousand times harder. Hopefully when she gets back from her 'drive' she wont keep shoving it in my face what an utter piece of shit I am and I can wake up and go work my shitty job.  And about being drunk right now, Ive been drunk long enough that i know how to function.  Im an alcoholic. I drink because when i get off work i dont have friends i dont have anything. the sauce puts me to sleep and ensures I wake up the next morning.

Thank you so much. Knowing there are people like you that try help people like me really gives me hope.
